title: Defaults of a garment spec (jacket on the bodice block)

doc.fit: side_ease per quarter at the side seam, dart_reduce (narrower waist darts), neck_widen, neck_drop (front), arm_drop (armhole lowered), across_out
doc.shoulder: extend (shoulder wider), pad (tip raised by the pad thickness)
doc.length: below_waist along each seam, hip_ease, hem (full hem circumference of a flared princess)
doc.front: extension past the centre front, buttons (heights below the neck point), hold_to (end of the fastened part)
doc.sleeve: type and the values of every sleeve type: see references/garment-spec.md
doc.facing: type (auto, width, panel), width from the front edge, back_neck depth

provenance.source: references/garment-spec.md and the technique sheet tailoring-outerwear.md
provenance.rights: Values compiled by the project, MIT like the code
provenance.notes: Values inside the ranges of the technique sheet; the outline they give was not compared to a published draft.
